Unmodified copies of firws.m, firwsord.m and windows.m from the EEGLAB firfilt plugin
(https://github.com/sccn/firfilt, commit ff8227f8; (c) Andreas Widmann, University of
Leipzig, GPL v2 or later, see the file headers and ../BergenToolboxModified/gpl-v2-license.txt).
Used by cwl_resample.m to build the same anti-aliasing filter as EEGLAB's pop_resample.
